note: Adversarial review findings from the Contrarian Shark (Devil's-Advocate) targeting the Master Plan draft for the Anchor Re-architecture.

findings.topic: Git deletion of tracked runtime files on pull
findings.section: Phase 4 — Phase 3 — Consolidation & Data Hygiene (C5 + C6)
findings.message: Executing `git rm --cached` on the ~62 tracked runtime artifacts will cause Git to delete those files from the working directory upon pulling/checking out the branch on the live server, destroying active state before the data migration script can run.

findings.topic: Supervisor pipe breakage on Windows restart
findings.message: On Windows, restarting the supervisor process will break anonymous stdout/stderr pipes shared with spawned child processes, causing those children to crash on subsequent writes and preventing the restarted supervisor from re-attaching to their output streams.

findings.section: Phase 3 — Phase 2 — Declarative Route Table & Default-Deny Auth (C2)
findings.message: Falling back to legacy if-elif chains means the routing is not default-deny by construction during the strangler migration period, exposing the system to auth bypasses for any route not yet explicitly migrated.

findings.topic: Unverified IPC protocol in test suite
findings.message: Relying exclusively on the 'inline' (in-process) supervisor seam for the test suite means the loopback token-authed IPC protocol and supervisor process boundaries are never covered by automated regression tests.
Replaying journal-ahead 'intent' events blindly to resolve divergence could force mutations that failed or were aborted in the authoritative legacy store, risking database corruption.

findings.topic: Permanent hybrid-state flags increase maintenance debt
findings.section: Phase 7 — Phase 6 — Closure: Hybrid-State Hardening & North-Star Scorecard (C7)
findings.message: Retaining the four pillar off-switch flags permanently as 'supported operational levers' introduces long-term testing and maintenance complexity, violating the Objective of creating a maintainable substrate.

findings.topic: Pre-emptive North Star C1 amendment proposal
findings.section: Phase 1 — Phase 0 — Ground Truth & Safety Rails (pre-wave instrumentation)
findings.message: Proposing to amend the North Star success criteria in Phase 0 if the census reveals a high interpolation count indicates a lack of commitment to the locked 7,000-line reduction bar.
The headers are offset by one (e.g. 'Phase 1 — Phase 0', 'Phase 2 — Phase 1'), creating confusing inconsistency throughout the document's structure.

findings.section: Appendix A — Idea→Phase Traceability Map (Round-1 hygiene: the absorption claim, made verifiable)
findings.message: Mitigation 9 is explicitly flagged as carrying no citation in the phase specifics, leaving a gap in the claimed risk mitigation coverage that must be reconciled.
